title: Blue View | KEY.co
description_expanded: Ascending to the second floor, the master suite is a sanctuary of relaxation, boasting a king-sized bed, an indulgent soaking tub, a walk-in shower, and a dual-sink vanity, all designed with meticulous attention to detail. Another bedroom offers tranquil lodging with a queen bed and an elegant bathroom. The inviting living area opens onto a balcony, presenting awe-inspiring views that make every moment memorable. The pinnacle of the home is the third floor, where the ceiling vaults over a sunlit den that merges seamlessly with a state-of-the-art kitchen, featuring stainless steel appliances and a large marble island. This level also includes a cozy breakfast nook and a spacious dining table positioned to embrace uninterrupted Gulf vistas. For ultimate relaxation, the balcony offers an outdoor swing bed and plush seating, ideal for basking in the coastal ambiance. Perched just steps from the Seaside Town Center, this exquisite beach vacation home is a masterpiece of luxury and comfort, offering panoramic views of the Gulf from its three sumptuous levels. The residence, highlighted as a 'dreamy beach bungalow' in the prestigious Garden & Gun magazine, caters flawlessly to up to 12 guests with its four bedrooms and four-and-a-half bathrooms. The ground level welcomes visitors with a delightful arrangement, featuring two queen-sized beds, a twin-over-twin bunk nook, and a comfortable living space. The serenity extends to a private guest bedroom with twin XL beds and a sleek glass shower, alongside a conveniently located laundry room.
